question: My daughter is a senior in high school and is interested in nursing. Does Ramapo offer a four-year nursing degree for incoming freshmen, or is it only for people who already have an RN?
answer:
Yes. Ramapo offers a Nursing Generic BSN, a Bachelor of Science in Nursing, with a generic track for students interested in becoming nurses—not only people who already have an RN. Its curriculum is designed for students to complete general education and science requirements in the first two years, then the two-year nursing sequence. [2]

The RN-to-BSN track is specifically for registered nurses with an associate’s degree or nursing diploma. [3] Ramapo also offers an accelerated BSN, but that is for students who already hold a non-nursing bachelor’s degree or have at least 60 credits from a regionally accredited institution, so it is not the described freshman track. [1]

The Nursing Generic BSN is also listed with Nursing MSN as another published level. [2]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BSN-NURA) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BSN-NURG) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BSN-NURS)

question: Could you tell me what courses are required for the Computer Science major, and roughly how many credits the major is in total?
answer:
The catalog lists the Computer Science BS, a Bachelor of Science major [13]. Requirements [1]:
• Required: CMPS 147 Computer Science I; 148 Computer Science II; 220 Assembly Language Programming; 231 Data Structures; 311 Operating Systems; 361 Software Design; 366 Organization of Programming Languages; 450 Senior Project; MATH 121 Calculus I; MATH 205 Mathematical Structures or MATH 237 Discrete Structures.
• Math electives—choose 2: MATH 122 Calculus II; 124 Calculus IV; 200 Independent Study: Mathematics; 225 Multivariable Calculus; 240 Cryptography; 245 Numerical Analysis; 253 Probability; 262 Linear Algebra; 282 Number Theory; 290 Topics; 300 Independent Study: Mathematics; 305 Differential Equations; 321 Geometry; 339 Complex Variables; MATH 353 Statistics or 370 Applied Statistics; 360 Stochastic Calculus for Finance; 390 Advanced Topics.
• CS electives—choose 7: CMPS 240 Data Analytics in Python or 285 Mobile Development; 305 Cyber Security; 310 Big Data Programming; 315 The Linux Environment; 320 Machine Learning; 327 Network Programming; 331 Artificial Intelligence; 335 Agent Engineering; 337 Computer Vision; 342 Computer Graphics; 345 Analysis of Algorithms; 350 Financial Modeling; 357 The .NET Environment; 364 Database Design; 367 Advanced Topics; 369 Web Application Development; 370 Cyber and Network Defense; 373 Object Oriented Programming; 375 Mobile Robotics; DATA 301 Data Analysis & Visualization. Also required: PATH 001, 002 and 003 Career Pathways Mods 1, 2 and 3 [1].
The catalog does not publish a total credit count for this major [1]. Its general undergraduate-major rule is at least 40 and no more than 64 credits [2]; that is a range, not a Computer Science-specific total.

question: We are comparing several colleges. What are the general education requirements at Ramapo, and how many credits do they add up to?
answer:
Ramapo students complete ten General Education courses: [8]
1. Four keystone courses: First Year Seminar, Social Science Inquiry, Critical Reading & Writing 102, and Studies in the Arts & Humanities. Critical Reading & Writing 102 must be taken within the first 64 credits. [8]
2. One course in each keystone category: Global Awareness, Historical Perspectives, Scientific Reasoning, and Quantitative Reasoning. Quantitative Reasoning must be taken within the first 64 credits. [8]
3. One course in two of the three distribution categories: Culture & Creativity, Systems, Sustainability, & Society, and Values & Ethics. At least one must be offered by a school other than the one housing your major. [8]
The catalog describes required courses and categories in the same way. [4] Transfer students may transfer in or be waived from some or all requirements. [3]
The pages do not state an exact total credit count for General Education. They say the curriculum “should not exceed 41 credits.” [5]

Sources: [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#general-education) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#general-education) [5](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/curriculum-and-assessment/)

question: My son wants to major in biology and possibly go on to medical school. What courses would he normally take in his first year?
answer:
The catalog lists the Biology BS [15]. Its recommended Biology (General) plan for students admitted in 2026–2027 gives these first-year courses [2]:

**Fall (18 credits):** BIOL 111 Fundamentals of Biology I Lecture and BIOL 111L Fundamentals of Biology I Lab; CHEM 116 General Chemistry I Lecture and CHEM 116L General Chemistry I Lab; CRWT 102 Critical Reading and Writing II; INTD 101 First Year Seminar.

**Spring (18 credits):** BIOL 113 Fundamentals of Biology II Lecture and BIOL 113L Fundamentals of Biology II Lab; CHEM 117 General Chemistry II Lecture and CHEM 117L General Chemistry II Lab; Quantitative Reasoning—MATH 110 Precalculus, MATH 121 Calculus I, or CMPS 147 Computer Science I (strongly recommended); a General Education Requirement; PATH 001 Career Pathways Mod 1.

The plan’s other tracks for that same year include “Biology: General Pre-Med Track” [2]. For that track’s specific first-year courses, contact the School of Science, Nursing, and Health Office: (201) 684-7734, SNHOffice@ramapo.edu, ASB-422.

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-BIOL) [15](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs)

question: Does Ramapo have an accounting major, and does it include the extra credits needed to sit for the CPA exam in New Jersey?
answer:
Yes. Ramapo lists Accounting BS, a Bachelor of Science major [17]. The catalog says the program is designed for students preparing for the CPA Exam’s “150-credit requirement.” It says the major prepares students to enter Ramapo’s Accounting 4+1 program and earn an M.S. in Accounting, thereby satisfying the 150-credit requirement [1].

The Accounting BS requirements also state that CPA candidates need a total of 150 credits; they do not specify particular courses and recommend pursuing a minor or program path [1]. The 2026–2027 recommended plan lists 128 total credits for the BS [1]. The pages describe the 4+1 route, but do not verify New Jersey-specific exam eligibility or state how many additional credits an individual student needs. The Accounting Club also encourages students to accumulate 150 undergraduate credits toward a CPA license [8].

Also published: Accounting 4+1, Accounting MS, and Accounting Minor [1]. For guidance, contact the Anisfield School of Business at asb@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7379.

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SB-BS-ACCT) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/accounting-club/) [17](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs)

question: I saw a course listed as PSYC 101 on a brochure. What does that course cover and are there any prerequisites?
answer:
PSYC 101 INTRODUCTION TO PSYCHOLOGY is 4 credits. It introduces psychology as a field of study and practice, including its history, methods and scope. Topics include learning, perception, cognition, emotion, motivation, abnormal behavior, psychotherapy, social behavior, personality, lifespan development, and the biological bases of thought, feeling and action. [2] The course has no published prerequisites. [2]

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/PSYC101)

question: What is the difference between the Business Administration major and the Economics major in terms of the classes required?
answer:
The catalog lists no bachelor’s major in Business Administration; it lists Business Administration as an MBA (Master of Business Administration) [14, 1]. So there is no bachelor’s Business Administration major to compare with Economics. [14]

The Economics BA requires: Quantitative Reasoning—choose 1: MATH 108, 110, or 121. ASB required courses: ACCT 221, 222; BADM 223, 225, 495; ECON 101, 102; FINC 301; INFO 224; MGMT 302, 370; MKTG 290. International Category—choose 1: ECON 323, 325; HNRS 220; IBUS 305, 321, 322, 326, 335, 336, or 340. Ethics Category—choose 1: BADM 301; HNRS 325; or INFO 315. Economics major courses: ECON 311 and 312, plus 5 electives chosen from ECON 253, 302, 303, 305, 310, 322, 323, 325, 330, 332, 335, 360, 390, or FINC 411. Also required: PATH 001, 002, and 003. [2]

question: Does Ramapo offer any certificate programs that a student could complete alongside their major?
answer:
Yes. Ramapo offers certificates for credit-bearing and/or non-credit-bearing experiences [6]. The catalog lists: Applied Ethics Certificate; Business Essentials Certificate; Business Foundations-Graduate Certificate; Data Analyst-Graduate Certificate; Data Modeler-Graduate Certificate; Machine Learning Engineer-Graduate Certificate; and Spanish for Health Care and Human Services Professionals Certificate [5]. Academic certificates are usually programs of study made up of credit-bearing courses; they are not graduation requirements and are removed from the degree audit [7].

Business Essentials is a Graduate Certificate [1]. It requires all of ACCT 221 PRINCIPLES OF FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING, MKTG 290 MARKETING PRINCIPLES AND PRACTICES, and MGMT 302 MANAGING ORGANIZATIONAL BEHAVIOR, plus one course from BADM 223 BUSINESS LAW I, INFO 224 PRINCIPLES OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, or FINC 301 CORPORATE FINANCE I [1]. Details: https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SB-UCR-BECP [1].

The catalog does not verify whether each certificate can be completed alongside every major or which certificates a particular student is eligible for. The Office of the Provost can help: provost@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7330 [6].

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SB-UCR-BECP) [5](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs) [6](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#certificate-programs1) [7](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#certificate-programs1)

question: Is there an environmental science major, and does it require a lot of chemistry and math courses?
answer:

question: If my son takes AP Calculus in high school, what math course would he typically start with in the Computer Science major, and what does MATH 121 require as a prerequisite?
answer:
The catalog’s 2026–2027 Computer Science BS plan starts with MATH 110 PRECALCULUS in First Year, Fall; it lists MATH 121 CALCULUS I in First Year, Spring [1]. AP exam score matters: a 4 or 5 on AP Calculus AB earns Calculus I credit; a 4 or 5 on BC earns Calculus I and II credit. Either score exempts him from the Calculus Placement Test [9]. A score of 3 on either exam earns no credit, but he may register for MATH 121 without the test [6][9].

MATH 121 (4 credits) requires either completed MATH 110 PRECALCULUS, or one of these placement-test options with the stated minimum scores: ACT Composite 026 AND ACCUPLACER College Level Math 095; ACCUPLACER Adv Alg & Fnctns 280; ACCUPLACER Elementary Algebra 082 AND ACCUPLACER College Level Math 095; or SAT MATH 580 AND ACCUPLACER College Level Math 095 [3].

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-CMPS) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/MATH121) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/testing/calculus/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/testing/math-placement/)
